channel.title: Stethos guides
channel.description: Guides to US healthcare market data for go-to-market and deal teams.

item.title: Your buyer changed jobs. Your CRM didn't notice.
item.description: Healthcare buyers change roles often and CRMs rarely notice. Why titles go stale so fast, what it costs, and what keeps your contacts current.

item.title: What CMS ownership files show about private equity in healthcare
item.description: CMS publishes who owns Medicare-enrolled hospitals, nursing homes, home health agencies and hospices, and flags private equity. What the files show.

item.title: What an MSO is, and why it changes how you sell to practices
item.description: More practices now sit under a management services organization. Here's what an MSO is, how private equity roll-ups use them, and how to work one as an account.

item.title: How to find out who owns a medical practice
item.description: A solo practice and a PE-owned one buy very differently. How to work out who owns a medical practice, step by step.

item.title: What the NPI registry can and can't tell you
item.description: The NPPES NPI Registry is the backbone of US provider data. Here's what it reliably tells you, where it falls short, and what to pair it with.

item.title: Why provider directories go stale, and what keeps them current
item.description: Provider directories drift out of date because clinicians move faster than the systems that track them. Here's where the errors come from and what helps.

item.title: Giving an AI agent healthcare data: a checklist
item.description: Before an AI agent acts on healthcare provider data, check freshness, provenance, identifiers, cost controls and patient privacy. A short checklist.
